subject: Cloud cost control platform renewal — evaluation notes & next steps
messages:
From: Kelsey Tran <kelsey@pennywise.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Morales <ethan.m@pennywise.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal + updated SOW for Redwood renewal

Hi Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is the updated pricing sheet (Pennywise_PRICING_Q3.pdf) and the SOW with the three-month pilot option expanded. Key highlights:

- Baseline monitoring + anomaly detection: up to 5 accounts / 50k resources included
- Reserved data ingest and retention: 90 days default; longer retention available as add-on
- Support SLA: 24x5 email + prioritized Slack during business hours; 99.5% dashboard availability SLA for the Dedicated plan

We’ve modeled the expected token/metric usage based on the APM export you shared. There’s room on the committed tier to include the spike buffer you asked for. I also attached our latest SOC 2 Type II (SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf) for your security review.

Next steps we propose:
1) Price lock and scope confirmation (this week)
2) Legal redlines — we can accept most commercial terms; will need to confirm data retention language
3) Rollout plan and connector review with your infra team (June 22–26)

Please confirm availability for a 30-minute sync on Mon 6/15 or Tue 6/16 to finalize pricing.

Best,
Kelsey
Enterprise Account Exec | Pennywise AI

Attachments: Pennywise_PRICING_Q3.pdf, SOC2-Type2-2025.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Tran <kelsey@pennywise.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal + updated SOW for Redwood renewal

Thanks Kelsey — quick read-through; appreciate the SOC2. A couple of points from our side before we lock: 

- Cost predictability is the top priority. We need clearer language on committed credits vs. overage pricing and how spikes above the buffer are billed (per-minute vs per-day aggregation).
- Can you provide an example invoice for a month with a 3x spike to show how it would break down?
- We need a 30% cap on price increases for contract years 2–3 (or an index-based cap tied to CPI).

Marissa — can you coordinate with Legal on the data residency / retention wording? Laura — can you confirm whether the 90-day retention baseline will meet CS review for investigation workflows? Aditya — please look at the connector requirements; I want a quick call next week with Pennywise infra.

Vivek
CTO | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Tran <kelsey@pennywise.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal + updated SOW for Redwood renewal

Kelsey — we can do Tue 6/16 at 11:00 PT for the sync. Laura and Neha will join for security and finance context. Agenda: pricing walk, example invoice, and connectors list.

Quick note from finance (Neha) — we are evaluating a 12-month commit with a quarterly true-up. We’ll need a playbook for how the spike buffer is consumed and replenished. Also please share the standard SOW redlines (we ran a quick scan and attached a redlines file — redlines_v1.docx).

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_v1.docx

From: Kelsey Tran <kelsey@pennywise.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Morales <ethan.m@pennywise.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@acme-procure.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposal + updated SOW for Redwood renewal

Great — see you on the call. In advance, I attached an example invoice showing a heavy-usage month with a 3.4x spike and how the billing ladder applies (included in Pennywise_PRICING_Q3.pdf).

On the price cap ask: we typically offer a 20% max increase year-over-year on committed plans. We can extend to 25% with a 12-month commit and minimum spend of $150k / quarter. If you need 30% cap, I can escalate to our Sales Ops leader but that will require additional discounting.

On retention: Pennywise supports region-tagged retention. We can guarantee EU/US residency per connector, and the 90-day default can be extended for forensic retention at an add-on.

See you on Tue.

Kelsey

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Kelsey Tran <kelsey@pennywise.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal + updated SOW for Redwood renewal

Quick technical notes from Infra: 
- Connector: we prefer a push-based lightweight agent (no long-lived IAM role access) — can Pennywise support that model? If not, need a risk assessment.
- Spike handling: architecture diagram requested — how does Pennywise scale ingestion during an abrupt 5x resource usage event? We need cold-start estimates and expected TTLs for metric backfill.
- Data export: we need easy export of raw metric payloads for internal debugging; please confirm an API or S3 dump option.

If you can share the connector spec, we’ll do a short security sign-off and demo the agent in our staging environment.

—Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Morales <ethan.m@pennywise.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kelsey Tran <kelsey@pennywise.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal + updated SOW for Redwood renewal

Vivek / team — thanks for the detailed questions. Short answers: 

- Agent model: yes, we have a push-agent that supports ephemeral credentials; we’ll send the connector spec (link included).
- Spike scaling: Pennywise auto-scales ingestion using a combination of provisioned burst credits and autoscaling groups; in our example invoice we show how a 3–5x spike would be amortized across the billing period. We’ll provide a brief architecture diagram and cold-start numbers by end of day Friday.
- Data export: we support scheduled S3 dumps (encrypted) and a raw API endpoint for exports.

I’ve attached the connector spec and the architecture sketch to the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bPennywiseEval (also added to the related_links above). We’ll await your security team’s staging access request and can provision a sandbox tenant.

Regards,
Ethan
Solutions Architect | Pennywise AI

Attachments: connector_spec.yaml (referenced), architecture_sketch.pdf
